name: Greenmarch
descriptionSeed: Greenmarch — the wood's-edge market: growers, foragers, and people who will not be told which side of the Accord they are on. The Quickwood argues about sealing; Greenmarch trades through the argument, and has for six generations.
encounterFlavor: traders, apprentices and people from three domains who have learned to share a street

substrateSource.reason: The Archive was sealed before the Transition and never opened to it. What is inside is still what was inside.
substrateSource.radiusNote: `radius` is in legacy map units; `radiusWorld` is RADII on the sphere and is the one mechanics should use. Chosen by sweep against the authored worldPos: at this scale all 26 sources resolve on the correct side of their region baseline and calibration drift stays ~0.05. Larger radii blanket a whole region (a source at ~55% strength everywhere inside it) and renormalization cancels the field flat — the failure CCode measured and reverted.
